description: Cross-site scripting: attacker-controlled data executed as script in another user's browser.
React renders values in braces as text nodes, so markup in strings is displayed, not executed.
Inserts a raw HTML string. Only use it with sanitized or fully trusted HTML.
Keep only explicitly permitted tags, attributes and URL protocols. Safer than trying to block known-bad patterns.
HTTP header that restricts where scripts may come from, blocking injected inline scripts.
Browser API that forces values written to DOM sinks like `innerHTML` to go through a vetted policy.
